mapper.insert: INSERT INTO waste_disposal(code, chemical_id, batch_id, type, qty, method, operator_id, status) VALUES(#{code}, #{chemicalId}, #{batchId}, #{type}, #{qty}, #{method}, #{operatorId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT w.*, ci.name AS chemical_name, ci.code AS chemicalCode, ci.cas_no AS casNo, ci.category AS category, ci.spec AS spec, ci.unit AS unit, cb.lot_no AS lotNo, uo.nickname AS operator_name, ua.nickname AS approver_name FROM waste_disposal w LEFT JOIN chem_info ci ON w.chemical_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN chem_batch cb ON w.batch_id = cb.id LEFT JOIN sys_user uo ON w.operator_id = uo.id LEFT JOIN sys_user ua ON w.approver_id = ua.id WHERE w.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM waste_disposal WHERE code LIKE CONCAT(#{dayPrefix}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE waste_disposal SET status = 1, approver_id = #{approverId}, finish_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE waste_disposal SET status = 2, approver_id = #{approverId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM waste_disposal WHERE status = 0

SELECT w.*, ci.name AS chemical_name, uo.nickname AS operator_name FROM waste_disposal w LEFT JOIN chem_info ci ON w.chemical_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN sys_user uo ON w.operator_id = uo.id WHERE w.status = 0 ORDER BY w.create_time ASC LIMIT 20
SELECT type AS "type", COUNT(*) AS "cnt", COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS "total_qty" FROM waste_disposal GROUP BY type ORDER BY type
